_comment: Guided tour of the user editor. Steps point at real controls. 'name' is the emtk control (table, field or action); 'key' / 'attr' / 'action' with the toolbar glyph label keep the legacy Qt tool's spotlight working.

steps.title: Who is registered
steps.text:
Every account in the MMFDB. Listing them is an administrator operation: if the table is empty and the status line under it says so, that is a permission, not a fault.

Type in the filter box above the rows to find an account, click a header to sort, and look for the star in the Active column: it marks the account ChiSurf uses for its own database connections.

steps.title: Pick one to edit
steps.text: Select a row and the account form on the right fills in. Everything you type stays local until you save, so you can look without changing anything.

await.hint: Click any row in the table.

steps.title: You are told before the server is
steps.text: A missing display name, a malformed e-mail, a website that is not a URL, a username already taken or one with spaces in it is reported above the fields as you type, not after a failed round trip. Change the Display name now and press Enter: the account counts as edited and Save and Revert become usable.

await.hint: Edit the display name and press Enter.

steps.title: Rights
steps.text: Administrator allows listing, editing and deleting users; the server refuses to remove the last one. Allow sign-in without a password is convenient on a single-user machine and is not offered to administrators.

steps.title: Passwords are staged, not sent immediately
steps.text: Password... opens a prompt that checks the strength of what you type and holds the result until you press Save: the status line then says one is waiting. Nothing is stored on this machine; the server keeps only a hash.

await.hint: Press Password..., look at the prompt, then close it with Cancel.

steps.title: Save, or throw it away
steps.text: Save writes the account back. Renaming also carries your stored session token across, so you stay signed in. Revert discards the edits after asking, and Delete asks before it removes the selected account.

await.hint: Press Save when you are happy with the account.
